structuredContent.assistant_response_guidance: Report the recorded run state and summarize the actual result. The latest_result may belong to an older run; compare its run_id with last_run.id before attributing output or failure to the latest run. Retries reuse the run ID and can retain earlier output; compare latest_result.created_at with last_run.started_at as well. Failed means a recorded attempt failed; retries or a later failure after producing output are possible. In_progress does not prove current worker liveness. No_update means a completed run with suppressed output. Null history does not prove the task never ran. Delivery is unknown, even when a published chat_ref exists. State when content is truncated or user action is required. Never infer success from last_run_time or completed_count.
